verdict.rationale: LibreChat's core interface is a natural-language chat. Through it, users drive agents that interpret code, run API actions, and call MCP tools such as file system and browser access, and they can invoke agents by @-mention in the chat input. However, the evidence shows the product itself (agent creation, configuration, settings) being operated through the Agent Builder panel, the Admin Panel and YAML files, not through natural-language commands. missing for 10: evidence that product operations such as configuring or managing agents can be done via natural-language commands, and independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language-driven operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Advanced agents with file handling, code interpretation, and API actions
LibreChat leverages MCP to dramatically expand what your AI agents can do, allowing you to integrate everything from file system access, web browsers, specialized APIs, to custom business tools.
Also by mention with "@" in the chat input.
